title: CreateDatabaseRequest
description: A request to create the database

subnetId.description: Override subnet where the database will be deployed. Disables Multi-AZ if set [only for AWS].

customUserTags.description: Optional tags to apply to launched infrastructure resources

disableMultiAz.description: Disable deployment into multiple availability-zones (the database will be deployed into one subnet).

attachedStorageForWorkers.description: Attached storage for the worker nodes for AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud providers.

numEdgeNodes.description: Number of edge nodes to be created for the database. A positive, non-zero number is required. The default value is 0.

enableRegionCanary.description: To enable the region canary for the database.

scaleType.description: Optional tags to choose one of the predefined cluster sizes.

storageType.description: Optional tag to choose the storage types.

enableGrafana.description: To enable grafana server for the database.

volumeEncryptions.description: Specifies encryption key to encrypt volume for instance group. It is currently supported for AWS cloud provider only.

gatewayNodesCount.description: Number of gateway nodes to be created for the database. When multiple gateway nodes are present Knox works in HA mode. A positive, non-zero number is required. The default value is 1. Requires the COD_RESTWORKERS entitlement.

restworkerNodesCount.description: Number of REST Worker nodes to be created for the database. A positive, non-zero number is required. The default value is 0. Requires the COD_RESTWORKERS entitlement.

architecture.description: Specifies the Architecture of the cluster nodes.

customInstanceTypes.description: Provide custom VM instance types for master, worker, gateway, leader, edge and compute groups.

ArchitectureType.description:
Architecture type for cluster.
 `X86_64` - X64 CPU Architecture is used for the cluster. `ARM64` - ARM64 CPU Architecture is used for the cluster.

AttachedStorageForWorkers.description: Attached storage for the worker nodes for AWS, Azure, and GCP cloud providers.

volumeCount.description: The number of Volumes. Default is 4. Valid Range: Minimum value of 1, maximum value 8.

volumeSize.description: The target size of the volume, in GiB. Default is 2048.

volumeType.description: The volume type. This parameter can be HDD or SSD. Default is HDD.

targetedValueForMetric.description: The target value of the metric a user expect to maintain for the cluster

maxWorkersForDatabase.description: Maximum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled up to.

maxWorkersPerBatch.description: Maximum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled up to in one batch.

minWorkersForDatabase.description: Minimum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled down to.

evaluationPeriod.description: Period of metrics(in seconds) needs to be considered.

minimumBlockCacheGb.description: The amount of block cache, in Gigabytes, which the database should have.

instanceGroup.description: Instance group to apply the recipe to.

InstanceGroupType.description:
InstanceGroup Type.
 `WORKER` - WORKER value of the InstanceGroup name. `LEADER` - LEADER value of the InstanceGroup name. `MASTER` - MASTER value of the InstanceGroup name. `GATEWAY` - GATEWAY value of the InstanceGroup name. `STRONGMETA` - STRONGMETA value of the InstanceGroup name. `EDGE` - EDGE value of the InstanceGroup name. `COMPUTE` - COMPUTE value of the InstanceGroup name. `RESTWORKER` - RESTWORKER value of the InstanceGroup name.

KeyValuePair.description: Generic key-value type, because map<> is not supported

ScaleType.description:
Scale type.
 `MICRO` - Create a 2-node cluster (1 gateway and 1 worker) with high availability disabled. `LIGHT` - Create a multi-node cluster with a light master and gateway instance type. `HEAVY` - Create a multi-node cluster with heavy master and gateway instance type.

StorageType.description:
Storage type for clusters.
 `CLOUD_WITH_EPHEMERAL` - Cloud with ephemeral storage. `CLOUD` - Cloud storage without ephemeral storage. `HDFS` - HDFS storage.

VolumeEncryption.description: Specify volume encryption key for instance group.

instanceGroup.description: Instance group to apply the encryption key to.

VolumeType.description:
Volume Type.
 `HDD` - Hard disk drives (HDD) volume type. Default is HDD. `SSD` - Solid disk drives (SSD) volume type. `LOCAL_SSD` - Local SSD volume type.
